cards.name: Whims of the Fates
cards.text: Starting with you, each player separates all permanents they control into three piles. Then each player chooses one of their piles at random and sacrifices those permanents. (Piles can be empty.)

cards.name: Charging Badger

cards.flavorText:
"If the hierarchies of nature were determined by ferocity alone, the badger would be lord of the beasts."
—Anthousa of Setessa

cards.name: Culling Mark

cards.flavorText: Hunt without Nylea's leave and you may find yourself the next quarry.

Reach
{3}{B}: This creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard. Activate only once each turn.
cards.flavorText: Cloaks woven from its webs are durable and waterproof but said to bring on nightmares.

cards.name: Hero of Leina Tower
cards.text: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, you may pay {X}. If you do, put X +1/+1 counters on this creature.
cards.flavorText: "You cannot achieve greatness if its seed has not already been planted in your heart."

cards.name: Hunter's Prowess
cards.text: Until end of turn, target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw that many cards."
cards.flavorText: To be counted among the warriors of Setessa's Leina Tower, you must not fear death, only failure.

cards.name: Karametra's Favor
cards.text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

cards.name: Mischief and Mayhem
cards.text: Up to two target creatures each get +4/+4 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText:
"The false god Xenagos treats the whole world as his rollick site. If his whims are left unchecked, Theros will be reduced to rubble and ashes."
—Elspeth

cards.name: Mortal's Resolve

cards.name: Swordwise Centaur
cards.flavorText:
The girl who would become the Champion of the Sun hacked furiously at the practice dummy. At last she stopped, breathing heavily, and looked up at her instructor. "So much anger," said the centaur. "I will teach you the ways of war, child. But first you must make peace with yourself."
—*The Theriad*

cards.flavorText: Thaumaturges of Theros have learned to weave their magic into the world around them, but it can be pulled apart strand by strand.
